newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint firms vs dlr, steady vs NBH basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint firms vs dlr, steady vs NBH basket.

text.p: Hungary's forint ended firmer against the dollar on Thursday and remained on the central banks' resistance level, dealers said.
"As long as the forint has positive real interest, there are always buyers ready to jump in when the Hungarian unit leaves the central bank's bid," said Ervin Csengeri of Inter-Europa Bank.
The forint finished at 176.50 against the U.S. unit compared with its morning opening of 176.68/73 and a midday quote of 176.50/55.
The forint traded fractionally below the central bank's resistance level throughout the day, Csengeri said.
The Hungarian unit moves within the central bank's 4.5 percent wide intervention range against a basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
